messages:
Sam: Quick idea 2: let's add a tiny 'fallback decision tree' micro-section to Dedicated provisioning docs so support can point to one place. Customers confuse reserved vs fallback paths. cc @nina @kevin

Nina: Love it. Keep it to 5 bullets max and add a copy-paste YAML + one CLI query. Short and to the point.

Kevin: I'll draft the decision tree and a diagnostic YAML. Decision tree should be: 1) reserved utilization, 2) per-variant quota/429s, 3) routing preferences, 4) regional failover, 5) fallback_policy caps.

docs-bot: Draft PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8120 (WIP) 1 lines added

Sam: Proposed micro-section (very short):
- Check ReservedCapacityUtilization. If <100% -> check fallback quota.
- Check logs for 'fallback_throttle' or 429 events on the fallback variant.
- Check per-request routing_preferences (SDK can opt-out of fallback).
- If cross-region failover in effect, confirm active variant differs by region.
- Verify fallback_policy.max_fallback_pct wasn't reached.

Kevin: Diagnostic YAML (copyable):
```yaml
provisioning:
  tenant: acme-examples
  reserved_capacity:
    gpus: 4
    model: rdl-large-v1
  scalePolicy:
    target_qps: 100
    cooldown_s: 90
    fallbackModel: rdl-medium-q1
    fallback_policy:
      max_fallback_pct: 30
      fallback_throttle_action: delay
  tenant_labels:
    isolation: medium
```

Nina: CLI queries for docs (two one-liners):
- logs: `redwoodctl logs query --tenant acme-examples --filter 'routing.variant=fallback OR routing.event=fallback_throttle' --last 15m`
- metric: `redwoodctl metrics query --metric ReservedCapacityUtilization --tenant acme-examples --last 15m`

sre-jen: Ops notes to include as a one-liner: fallback is best-effort overflow and does NOT reduce contractual reserved throughput; latency SLOs may differ for fallback requests. Also mention cross-region variant mismatch can look like fallback in some Console views.

billing-alfie: Billing note: routed-to-fallback requests are billed at the variant's rate and count toward tenant usage. Add a line so customers understand invoice diffs.

Sam: I'll add a tiny FAQ entry: 'Why did 25% of my traffic hit fallback?' -> check max_fallback_pct, reserved utilization, per-request opt-outs, and per-variant quota.

Kevin: I'll fold this into the provisioning guide as a micro-section (<=8 lines) and include links to SLA/quota docs (internal). Will ping to review.

docs-bot: PR updated with micro-section, YAML, CLI, FAQ. Reviewers requested: @nina @kevin @sre-jen @billing-alfie

Nina: Quick nit: spell out cooldown_s (seconds) in the YAML comment so non-devs aren't confused.

Sam: Merged after tiny edits. Closing thread. :tada:
